title: Porto and Sydney regionals (7 Nov): still no results online
detail: Limitless's One Piece tournament list still ends at 26 Jul 2026, so winners and decks from 7 Nov are unconfirmed. Will report when they appear.

title: Miyata Kard Market (Réunion): Delta Reign now mostly sold out, restock listed for 17 Nov
detail: Today's page shows only the Bundle of 6 boosters (€44.99, was €49.99) on sale. Elite Trainer Box (€79.99), Display 36 (€239.99), single booster (€7.99) and 3-pack (€19.99) show 'Épuisé'. The shop marks the French items as pre-orders with expected arrival 17/11/2026. Yesterday's note of the display and boosters being in stock no longer holds.

title: OP-18: English date of 20 Nov is reported but still unconfirmed
detail: A retailer comparison article gives 20 Nov (English) and 21 Nov (Japan) and says these match the official pages, but I could not open Bandai's page myself (it returned 'not found' yesterday). Earlier sources mixed 20, 21, 22 and 28 Nov. Wait for Bandai before relying on a date.

title: Flowing Fists (English ME7): 5 Feb 2027 still not official; Aura Seeker out in Japan 27 Nov
detail: Reports still say prereleases from 23 Jan and release on 5 Feb 2027, but they come from news sites, not The Pokémon Company. Japanese Aura Seeker (Mega Lucario Z ex) is reported for 27 Nov 2026. No new official announcement today.

title: Price check: no 20% moves
detail: TCGdex Cardmarket data: Mew ex 152 7-day avg €84.09 vs 30-day €90.08 (−7%); Pikachu ex 150 €51.38 vs €55.00 (−7%); Mega Darkrai ex 116 €172.30 vs €179.55 (−4%). All under the 20% threshold. Collection-wide checks still need TCGdex ids in the collection file.
